headline: Basin rig count up three as prices drop
summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up three this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 263 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 256 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is unchanged from last week at 588 rigs. A year ago, 539 rigs were active.
